findings.title: Successful scratch cleanup deletes a concurrently replaced foreign directory
findings.reproduction: Use real CompiledBuild.build and ArtifactStore, stub only semantic/profile stages and publication. At publication end rename the owned stage aside, create a new directory at its old path with foreign.txt. Current build returns compiled, rmtree deletes the foreign directory and retains the renamed actual owned stage.
findings.minimum_fix: Bind the stage created by this call to device/inode and only clean the still-owned directory; preserve replaced foreign paths.

findings.title: Cache-hit success does not verify published resource and record assets
findings.reproduction: Populate the real cache via one build with stubbed semantic publication and real ArtifactStore assets; alter the returned CSS resource bytes. The second identical identity/source call still returns mode compiled with a descriptor whose SHA no longer matches its path. HTML/profile/runtime remain valid.
findings.minimum_fix: Revalidate every returned resource and record/evidence asset on cache handoff, using the same expected SHA/length and closed artifact store rules.

test_note.title: Bare test_study_compiled_profiles import fails under ordinary module invocation
test_note.minimum_fix: Use package-qualified import or the worker test existing importlib fixture loader.
